import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # strip whitespace from text columns
    for col in ["Category", "Region", "Product", "Date", "Price"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype(object).apply(lambda x: x.strip() if isinstance(x, str) else x)
    # normalise Category label variant
    if "Category" in df.columns:
        df["Category"] = df["Category"].astype(str).str.strip()
    # Price is text with $ and numbers written as text
    if "Price" in df.columns:
        df["Price"] = df["Price"].astype(str).str.replace(r"[\$,]", "", regex=True).str.strip()
        df["Price"] = pd.to_numeric(df["Price"], errors="coerce")
    # Quantity to numeric
    if "Quantity" in df.columns:
        df["Quantity"] = pd.to_numeric(df["Quantity"], errors="coerce")
    # Date parsing, some non-ISO values
    if "Date" in df.columns:
        df["Date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["Date"], errors="coerce", utc=False)
    # drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # enforce Revenue = Quantity * Price cross-column rule
    if {"Quantity", "Price"}.issubset(df.columns):
        df["Revenue"] = df["Quantity"] * df["Price"]
    # keep only rows usable for revenue per month
    df = df.dropna(subset=["Date", "Quantity", "Price", "Revenue"])
    return df

def answer(df):
    dfc = clean(df)
    dfc["month"] = dfc["Date"].dt.strftime("%Y-%m")
    totals = dfc.groupby("month", dropna=True)["Revenue"].sum()
    # return plain dict with numeric values
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in totals.items()}
